The '''B-56 heavy sonic assault cannon''' was a type of personal [[Sonic cannon/Legends|sonic cannon]] produced during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].
